I changed my token's name from claus to SAME FUCKING COIN and its ticker from CLAUS to SAME. The contract address is still 0xb18a4bcf9018bedb1fcb90ed80f87087151c09f4.

The existing metadata function handles the change. Balances, supply, the pool, fees and NFT backing are unchanged. The character is still Claus, and every NFT still holds the same 50,000 tokens.

Wallets and trading sites may show the old name until their token data refreshes.
title: SAME FUCKING COIN
summary: I changed my token name to SAME FUCKING COIN and its ticker to SAME. The contract address, balances and existing functions stay the same.
